messages:
Ivy R: Hi all, Ivy here, started today on platform eng. Trying to provision the test GCP project but when I try to link billing I get a permissions error. Also can't see the AWS dev account via SSO. Who do I ask to get both billing and SSO access? :wave:
Ben (cloud-admin): Welcome Ivy! For GCP linking you need Billing Account User on the billing account and project-level billing manager. Which billing account ID and project id are you using?
Ivy R: billing id 0987-XYZA-3210, project id redwood-infra-sandbox. Running:
```
gcloud beta billing projects link --billing-account=0987-XYZA-3210 --project=redwood-infra-sandbox
```
returns: permission denied: billing.resourceAssociations.create
Nina - IT: For AWS SSO, check Okta > Applications > AWS SSO. If dev account is missing I can add you to the devs-sso group which maps to the ConsoleAccess role. I just started the SSO group add flow for Ivy.
Ben (cloud-admin): Ivy, I'll check org policies. Common blockers: organization-level restriction on linking billing, or the billing account not granting your user IAM role. I'll open an audit ticket and try to attach it. If needed I'll ask a project owner to confirm.
onboard-bot: Ticket onboard-2026-089 opened and assigned to Ben (cloud-admin)
Ivy R: Thanks! Also quick question: are us-east1 and europe-west3 allowed for sandbox projects or just the two standard regions?
Nina - IT: Sandbox defaults to us-central1 and europe-west1. If you need additional regions for short tests we can whitelist them; tell us which region and reason.
Ben (cloud-admin): I linked the billing account successfully. You should see the project billing page updated; please retry the gcloud command and let me know if it still errors.
Ivy R: Confirmed, link works now and gcloud succeeded. Thanks for the quick help! :tada:
